messages:
cheng: quick question — proposing we surface per-route SLO thresholds and a lightweight 'noise index' in Console. want feedback before i wire a prototype.
maria: do we mean editable thresholds per-tenant in the UI, or read-only values taken from the canonical SLO policy? big difference for ownership.
samir: editable is fine but must preserve notify_policy bindings. if tenant changes threshold we need to keep notify_policy idempotent (so we don't fanout duplicate alerts).
elaine: also: telemetry cost. 1-min windows per-route for 1000 tenants => large cardinality. can we use sampling + server-side smoothing?
cheng: yeah thinking: defaults from SLO policy, editable by admin. UI edits create a "console override" resource that references the canonical SLO id. show provenance on the UI.
samir: proposal for API payload shape (rough):
POST /api/v1/slo/thresholds
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "thresholds": {"p95_latency_ms": 200, "error_rate_p90": 0.005},
  "source": "console-ui",
  "notify_policy": "np-789"
}
elaine: +1 but add a sampling hint so we don't enable 1-min ingest for every tenant. e.g. sampling_hint: {"mode":"adaptive","target_rps":5}
maria: UI considerations: show "quiet window" toggle, and a quick link to revert to policy default. also a small confidence badge if sampling is in effect.
devex-bot: docs updated: <https://go/redwood/slo-console-proposal|slo console proposal> (added API sketch and UX mock)
cheng: question for eng-platform: who owns the schema? my vote: eng-platform owns runtime + API, devex owns UX surface. i'll prototype contract if ok.
samir: i'll own the server-side contract and ensure audit log + rate limits. also we should emit a metric for "console_override_applied" per-tenant so we can alert on misuse.
elaine: i'll run cost estimates and suggest aggregation windows (1-min for hot routes, 5-min for others). will post numbers in the doc.
maria: ok sounds good. i'll add a small mock and wire the revert flow. can we aim for a tiny demo by EOW? :eyes:
cheng: yes — plan: @samir spec payload + server flags, @maria UX mock, @elaine cost calc. i'll do a quick prototype of the API and backend toggle.
ops-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: — "assigned: samir, maria, elaine, cheng"
samir: one more nit: we need a rollout strategy — start with internal tenants + opt-in beta, watch alert fanout telemetry for 48h, then expand.
maria: agree. I'll add opt-in copy and guardrail in the mock.
